summary: Richard 'Dick' Marchman, 66, EMT and Indian Peaks Fire Protection District Chief Medical Officer (also Allenspark FD), collapsed and died ~1 mi from the Blue Lake Trailhead while returning from the Katherine Powell broken-ankle rescue (id 2847); fellow EMTs on the mission attempted CPR but he was pronounced deceased at the scene.
location: Blue Lake Trail, ~1 mi from trailhead, Brainard Lake Recreation Area
responding_agency: Indian Peaks Fire Protection District + Allenspark Fire Department + Nederland Fire + Rocky Mountain Rescue + AMR + Flight for Life + Boulder County Sheriff (on the Katherine Powell mission)
notes: Rescuer line-of-duty death during an SAR mission; distinct from id 2847 (the rescue subject survived with a broken ankle). Obituary confirms 'passed away unexpectedly on Wednesday, July 9, 2014, after rescuing a stranded hiker.' In scope: documented fatality with public reporting tied to an SAR mission. No prior rescuer-death rows; none found in dedupe.
